header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.desc: Open source tool for safety analysis and risk assessment on construction projects.

why.title: Why Open Safety Studio?
why.desc: Safety on the construction site is not a luxury but an obligation. Open Safety Studio helps with creating risk inventories, health & safety plans and safety checks, linked to the BIM model so risks become spatially visible.

features.title: Features
features.risk_desc: Systematic inventory of safety risks per construction phase, location and type of work in accordance with occupational health and safety legislation.
features.vg_desc: Automatically generate Health & Safety plans based on the risk inventory and project data.
features.checks_desc: Digital checklists for safety inspections on the construction site. Register deviations and track corrective actions.
features.ifcx_desc: Link risks and safety measures to specific locations and elements in the BIM model via IFCX.
features.incident_desc: Register incidents, near-misses and unsafe situations. Analyze patterns and take preventive measures.
features.reporting_desc: Generate reports for internal audits and external supervisors. Prove compliance with laws and regulations.
